method.transport: Real loopback WebSocket; one isolated official daemon for both paths; SDK 0.16.0-beta.1
method.cold: Fresh repository directory and application comparison keys, warm OS filesystem cache; startup and corpus construction excluded
method.order: Rotate all three modes each round; never benchmark modes concurrently; idle 1100 ms before each mode to drain the preceding Git start-rate window
method.nativeHighlight: paseo-highlight uses default server syntax highlighting; paseo-plain disables it as a control
method.pluginAll: Diagnostic eager load: first file then remaining files with six concurrent RPCs; normal plugin UI only loads selected files
method.cache: GitLens repeats one cached file RPC; Paseo repeats the whole cached comparison while original subscription remains active; different scopes
method.expiry: GitLens waits 1100 ms outside timing, then reads an already cached file; includes mandatory snapshot revalidation
method.traffic: Server-to-client WebSocket payload bytes while operation is active; excludes TCP/WebSocket framing, requests, and handshake
method.ui: No browser rendering or FPS measured; plugin visibleHighlightMs separately runs current syntax state, split-row model and first 40 patch lines
method.submodules: Coverage diagnostic; native root comparison has 20 files, GitLens recursively returns 200; timings are not equivalent work
